description: A shell script for testing Git history visualization, including setup of commits, branches, merges, and various log output checks related to 'TREESAME' and history limiting.

methods.name: note
methods.description: Tags a Git commit with a given label.

methods.name: unnote
methods.description: Processes Git revision names to remove tag annotations.

methods.name: check_outcome
methods.description: Runs a Git log command with specified parameters and compares output to expected.

methods.name: check_result
methods.description: Wrapper to check successful Git log output with specific parameters.
